Well, some time has passed and I finally feel ready to write this review.

I want to leave a negative review about this clinic, more specifically about the lack of competence shown by the doctors in my case.
Two years ago I came to this clinic with my cat (who unfortunately passed away a week ago) because I noticed she was breathing too fast. After the consultation, she was diagnosed with constipation. The appropriate medications were prescribed and, when I asked why she was breathing that way, I was told it was caused by intestinal pain.
The next day, the situation began to worsen. I began to suspect that it wasn't just pain or constipation, because the prescribed medications weren't producing any improvement. As the night progressed, her condition became increasingly worrying and my anxiety increased.
At 1:30 am we ended up going to an emergency veterinary hospital. My cat was immediately hospitalized in very serious condition. The doctors told me that if we had waited a few more hours, she could have died. They managed to save her life by a hair's breadth.
The correct diagnosis was Feline Hypertrophic Cardiomyopathy (HCM), a chronic heart disease.
If the veterinarian in charge of this clinic had correctly identified the problem the day before, this extremely serious situation could have been avoided. The disease was already in such an advanced state that, for the next two years of her life, my cat had to take medication every day, twice a day. I am convinced that earlier detection would have allowed for much smoother management of the disease and a better quality of life.

Unfortunately, a week ago, my beloved cat passed away.

I would also like to mention a situation that always made me uncomfortable. Before this episode, we went to this clinic several times for vaccinations and also for my cat's sterilization.

Before attending this clinic, my cat was extremely calm with veterinarians at another clinic. She never showed fear and cooperated without problems. However, after the sterilization and other procedures performed here, she developed an intense fear of hospitals and veterinarians.
I especially remember the day I picked her up after surgery. She was in a state of extreme agitation, jumping uncontrollably inside the cage. Her condition was so worrying that I had to leave her hospitalized for another night so she could calm down.

Naturally, I cannot say what happened when she was away from me, nor do I have any way of proving any inadequate treatment. However, the radical change in her behavior left me with many doubts and concerns.

The experience I had with this clinic ended up having very serious consequences for my cat's health and quality of life. It is deeply painful to look back and think that some of that suffering could perhaps have been avoided with a correct and timely diagnosis.

This is my personal experience and the reason why I cannot recommend this clinic.
I received poor service. I do not recommend them.

We had an excellent visit with this vet. She was knowledgeable, kind, and very professional throughout.

She even spoke to our dog, I Dare You, in Portuguese! This put all of us at ease--who knew. We were impressed by the communication of the office prior to our visit and the thoughtful attention to detail.

Everything was handled efficiently, including the required paperwork, and she made the entire process smooth and straightforward.

Thanks to the Doctor's guidance, we can now travel easily with I Dare You’s EU passport between Canada and the UK. A truly positive experience from start to finish.

We just relocated from Singapore to the Algarve with 4 kitties and we cannot begin to thank the amazing staff @ResteloVet in Lisbon. The whole process of communication was made easy, no barrier of language or understanding the rules. Beatriz was so quick to respond on our queries & she even booked us to get ready for our pet EU passport. Upon arrival Raquel was expecting us at the Veterinary, it is tucked away on this beautiful street and we met Dr. Sophia. She was so through with the animal inspection but yet so calm, my kitties already understood her portuguese requests. Dr.Sophia explained to us on each cats what is necessary to look out for future diseases which I think was very much appreciated. The Pet passports were ready in 1 days time.FurParents that are in need of help and especially to have a peace of mind when in another country we highly recommend this Veterinary clinic and wish them the very best wishes and great fortune .

I had an excellent experience from booking to receiving the service. It was the first time I took my kitten for a bath and grooming; she has long fur and had some difficult knots. She was very well cared for, she looked beautiful and smelled wonderful. You can see the care they give to the animals. Thank you to the lovely staff for their kindness. Kisses from Preta 🐾
